SV-11101:
h2. Description

Before anyone reorders a technician's work orders, *Tech View and Board View should list them in the List's default order* (customer name A-Z), *ties included*: work orders for the same customer go by start date, newest first.

For example,

* one technician leads three work orders for customers whose names sort differently
* nobody has reordered that technician's work yet
* Tech View and Board View list them in the order they were created, not A-Z
* two work orders for the same customer are also the wrong way round: the older one comes first, not the newer one

This appears inconsistent with the requirement defined in *Epic SV-10043* and the *PRD* (S2-R6). The same check worked on the QA branch on 9 October. On staging it fails (15 and 16 Oct 2026).

h2. Steps to Reproduce

# Create three work orders in this order, for customers *Zeta Hauling*, *Alpha Freight* and *Mid Trucking*, all with the same lead technician (one who leads nothing else).
# Sign in as a user who has never reordered work or changed the List sort, open *Work Orders* > *All* > *List*.
#* The three show as *Alpha Freight, Mid Trucking, Zeta Hauling* (List's default, customer A-Z).
# Click *Tech View* and find that technician's group; then click *Board View* and find that technician's column.
#* Both show *Zeta Hauling, Alpha Freight, Mid Trucking* — the order they were created.
# Create a second work order for *Mid Trucking* with the same lead technician, then look at List, Tech View and Board View again.
#* List shows the two Mid Trucking work orders newest first (16 Oct: {{S2-36360}} before {{S2-35905}}).
#* Tech View and Board View show them oldest first ({{S2-35905}} before {{S2-36360}}).

*Actual Result:*

* Before any reorder, a group/column lists its work orders in creation order.

*Expected Result:*

* Before any reorder, a group/column uses the List's default order: *Alpha Freight, Mid Trucking, Zeta Hauling*.
* Two work orders for the same customer go by start date, newest first, exactly as the List shows them.

h2. Environment

* *Build:* {{v26.40.17-a5c4210}} (15 Oct) and {{v26.40.18-7d85b7d}} (16 Oct) on [staging|https://app.staging.shopview.com/workorders]
* *Location:* Staging Heavy Duty - 9919 · *User:* a brand-new user with no saved sort or order · *Lead technician:* Carol Neal
* *Example records:* {{S2-35903}} (ZZAUTOTEST Zeta Hauling ZZ96929, made first), {{S2-35904}} (Alpha Freight ZZ96929), {{S2-35905}} (Mid Trucking ZZ96929), {{S2-36360}} (Mid Trucking, made 16 Oct) — search "ZZ96929" on staging

h2. Sources

* [PRD – Work Orders Board View & Tech View|https://shopview.atlassian.net/wiki/pages/viewpage.action?pageId=845185030] — page 845185030, version 58, S2-R6, read 16 Oct 2026 (the tie rule was added in version 53, 15 Oct 2026):
{quote}Before a manual order is saved, use the List’s default work order sort, ties included, exactly as the List sorts today: work orders for the same customer go by start date, newest first. The List itself does not change. A work order that gets a new lead after it was created goes to the bottom of that technician’s work instead (S9-R14).{quote}
